name: Review an agent's proposal like a pull request
description: The plugin's propose skill has the agent write the change as prose in .lastro/proposals/<id>-<slug>.md, run lastro propose (answering handoffs itself), show the user the review the plugin renders as Markdown (the PostToolUse hook adds it to the agent's context after the first lastro command that shows a new or re-extracted proposal in a session, and a one-line summary after later ones; lastro-plugin.mjs review prints it), then ask the user every open decision and, per intent, shown with the existing proofs it replaces, approve, request changes (amend) or reject, recording only the user's answers with lastro review --as <user>, until lastro status is ready; then lastro derive writes the proposal's proofs. The PreToolUse hook makes every lastro review command that approves, answers, amends or rejects show a Claude Code permission prompt, and denies it in both harnesses when --as names an agent (claude, codex, agent, assistant, ai, bot). With a policy above one approval the board shows each intent's approvals out of the required number and the proposal waits for the other reviewers.
